name: v0.3.13 — Mobile Stash gets Sort + Category filter pills
releaseNotes:
• Mobile Stash now matches web's sort + filter UI: dropdown for Recent / A-Z / Top $ / Most owned, plus horizontal-scroll category pill row above the item list (tap a category emoji to filter, tap All to clear). Counts shown per pill.
• calculateGuacoScore Dart port + 17-case cross-platform fixture suite. Web 51/51, Mobile 55/55 — same engines, identical numbers.
• Mobile /guacanomics gets the 5 summary tiles the web shows (Net Spent · Refunded · Bank Bite · Receipts · Tax Paid).
• Web's bankAccountTotals fixed — synthesizes a placeholder account when user has bank_fees but no statements (closes the 50/100 baseline-trap mismatch with mobile).
